name: up-next
title: Up next: a bounded shortlist, Library, Margins
summary: The Following tab becomes Up next: a shortlist that fits one screen and never scrolls far: continue listening, the newest unplayed episode from each show (one card per show, 'and 2 more' opens the Show screen), items you added but haven't started, and a shared Margin to hear. Shows and feed management move to Settings as one list, Shows you follow, with the Show screen under it. The Library holds items only: one sortable list with clusters built from metadata (publisher, published date, topic, date added). This is the owner's own idea, answered as a challenge.
shared_fixes: Margins stay grouped by item, with Share beside each item's heading. Groups are ordered by their most recent Margin and that Margin carries a Newest label, so the newest one is in the first group. Inside a group the Margins keep source order. A Margin row plays its moment; its chevron opens its details.
Margin details offer Share this Margin (a one-Margin packet to the share sheet).
Item details show the published date and the date added.
Export all Margins is one toolbar button on the Margins tab that hands a Markdown bundle to the share sheet; the folder export moves under Settings.
Settings is one tap from every tab (gear). The Library's options menu is removed; Help lives in Settings.
Clear reproducible audio is a button on Settings itself; Offline Storage keeps the detail.
Unfollow lives on the Show screen with an Undo toast instead of a confirmation alert; no landing tab manages a feed.
Settings sections: Voice, Storage, Notes folder, Import & export (collapsed to two rows), Help, About & legal (collapsed).

screens.title: Up next
screens.note: A ranked shortlist, capped at about eight cards: Continue listening; one card per show with its newest unplayed episode ('and 2 more' opens the Show screen); items added but not started; a shared Margin to hear. A noisy show contributes one card. Quiet shows contribute none. Quiet and Unfollow live on the Show screen; nothing on this tab manages a feed.
